about: Requests for tests/eval/cast_classification.py, labelled before any run: the cast Understanding should give, one row per individual (a count expands), as kind (human, animal, creature, robot, object: an object only when it acts as a character) and gender (male, female or "" when the request does not state it for that character). known: the established character's name. objects on display are no characters. Added later, still labelled before any run: known characters of either sex, together, non-human, overridden by the request, and an unknown name.

cases.request: a couple dancing in the rain
a girl hiding behind her father
a bride walking down the aisle
a cat sleeping on a sofa
a male cat stretching in the sun
a female wolf howling at the moon
a talking teapot telling a story
three friends and a robot playing cards
a robot waving, she smiles at the camera
